content.text: {"label":"unknown_supply_issue","confidence":"low","explanation":"From 12:00, agents on the phones dropped well below plan in both queues: payments had 24 and then 23 against 31 and 29 planned, and general had 24 and then 21 against 27 planned. Service level fell to 19.6% and 47.4% in payments and to 24.7% and 11.7% in general. The attendance log shows 0 absences in either queue and no incident or calendar entry explains it, so the cause of the staffing gap is unknown; it's worth checking for lunch breaks or meetings scheduled off plan, or a phone or login problem. General volume is also running 26.6% over forecast today, spread evenly across call reasons with no matching campaign.
